mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.project_id, m.user_id person_id, m.role_id, m.professional_role_id, coalesce(pr.role_name, m.specialty_role) as specialty_role, pr.role_code as professional_role_code, pr.role_name as professional_role_name, m.responsibility, m.join_date, m.exit_date, m.status, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, u.user_name person_code, u.nick_name person_name, d.dept_name, r.role_code, r.role_name, (select count(*) from pm_project_task i where i.project_id = m.project_id and i.assignee_user_id = m.user_id and i.task_type = 'EXECUTION') task_count, (select count(*) from pm_project_task i where i.project_id = m.project_id and i.assignee_user_id = m.user_id and i.task_type = 'EXECUTION' and i.status = 'COMPLETED') completed_task_count, (select count(*) from pm_project_task i where i.project_id = m.project_id and i.assignee_user_id = m.user_id and i.task_type = 'EXECUTION' and i.status <> 'COMPLETED' and i.plan_end_date < curdate()) overdue_task_count from pm_project_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id join pm_project_role r on r.role_id = m.role_id left join pm_professional_role pr on pr.professional_role_id = m.professional_role_id
mapper.select: where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.user_id = #{personId} and m.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_member(project_id, user_id, role_id, professional_role_id, specialty_role, responsibility, join_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectId}, #{personId}, #{roleId}, #{professionalRoleId}, #{specialtyRole}, #{responsibility}, #{joinDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update role_id = values(role_id), professional_role_id = values(professional_role_id), specialty_role = values(specialty_role), responsibility = values(responsibility), join_date = values(join_date), exit_date = null, status = 'ACTIVE', remark = values(remark), update_by = values(create_by), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update pm_project_member set role_id = #{roleId}, professional_role_id = #{professionalRoleId}, specialty_role = #{specialtyRole}, responsibility = #{responsibility}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
select * from pm_project_role where status = '0' and (project_id = 0 or project_id = #{projectId}) order by system_flag desc, sort_order, role_id
select * from pm_project_role where project_id = 0 and role_code = #{code} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_role(project_id, role_code, role_name, system_flag, status, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, '0', '0', #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_project_role set role_name = #{roleName}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where role_id = #{roleId} and system_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_member where role_id = #{roleId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
